title: anthoxanthum odoratum var. furumii
intro: Anthoxanthum odoratum var. furumii, commonly known as sweet vernal grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. It is known for its fragrant flowers and is often used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the body, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of sweet vernal grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
